title: Slovakian Potatoes Dumplings
description: A traditional Slovakian dish featuring floury potatoes and long-fermentation-dough, this recipe is paleo-friendly and makes for a great solo dinner, with a mustardy and molten flavor profile.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine flour, yeast, salt, and caraway seeds.
Gradually add warm water to the bowl and mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a cloth, and let it ferment in a warm place for 2 hours.
Boil the potatoes until they are tender, then mash them in a bowl with mustard and egg, if using.
Divide the fermented dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk and place a spoonful of mashed potatoes in the center of each disk.
Fold the dough over the potatoes and press the edges together to seal the dumplings.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and gently add the dumplings to the pot.
Cook the dumplings for 10 minutes, or until they float to the surface.
